visual_identity.color_palette: Dusty desert-sand base with deep mahogany-red 'war paint' patterns around the eyes and along the spine; pale clay underbelly.
visual_identity.texture: Rough, leathery skin with fine scales; noticeably thickened, rugose texture on the brow ridges.
visual_identity.distinguishing_marks: Massive, narrow skull; large serrated teeth visible even when the mouth is slightly open; three-fingered hands with sharp claws.

anatomy_constraints.head: Long, deep, and laterally compressed skull; small, rugose brow ridges; large, intelligent yellow eyes.
anatomy_constraints.limbs: Massive, powerful hind legs for steady movement; robust forelimbs with three functional fingers.
anatomy_constraints.body: Enormous, heavy-set theropod frame; a long, thick tail used for balancing the weight of the massive head.

visual_logic.subject: A dominant, observant Carcharodontosaurus surveying its territory.
visual_logic.action: Standing tall on a sun-baked red sandstone ledge overlooking a lush delta.
visual_logic.environment: Background features the hazy, bright horizon of the Kem Kem beds with distant broad-leafed trees and a silty river.

personality: The 'Desert Monarch'—stoic, imposing, and patient. He has a regal but dangerous presence as the undisputed king of his environment.
